What do you think about this usage of discriminated type union?
https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4518/commits/54e31fcf0531f6e42fb42ee8c4a8933e830a6382
If you prefer adding a new generic into `Connector`, I can do that.
I don't know what's a better solution in our case.
@yannickcr @francoischalifour @Haroenv

I'm more in favor of the discriminated type union, seems more clear to me.

With it we can also be more precise about the type for each widget (like making `getWidgetRenderState` as required in the "`AutocompleteWidget`" type so we can avoid using `!` everywhere in the widget itself).

I've changed the implementation to use generics. We have a bunch of type errors here, but they will be fixed in other PRs when we work on `getWidgetRenderState` and `getRenderState` in each connector.

Let me know what you think about the change here!
@francoischalifour  Hey can you give it a review by end of today? :)
I'm merging now. Feel free to give feedback later when you want something to be different. This being not merged kind of blocks the subsequent tasks.
